title: docs: cite landing commits where pending changesets and source docblocks name ten objectui issues that answer 404 (objectui#10771)
body:
Fixes #10771
Clause-②: no

Dispatched implementation of the `domain:ui` seat #1 claim (comment `5856991289`) on objectui#10771, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`. Citations only: no sentence's claim moves, no code or type token moves, and every edited pending changeset's frontmatter is byte-identical.

The one site round 1 left open, the runtime message string in `assertObjectMetadataWritable`, was repaired in a patch round (commit `c050ffe05`) under the seat surface amendment (comment `5857374350` on objectui#10771), so this PR closes the card.

## Premise, re-measured

- REST `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/N`: all ten (#5793, #6943, #7014, #7627, #7638, #7753, #7791, #7878, #8057, #9230) answer 404. Lit control: objectui#10533 answers 200.
- Census instrument: `git grep -nE` over the tree for `(objectui#|#|issues/)` followed by one of the ten and a non-digit, each hit classified by its path (changeset = `.changeset/`; src-nontest = `packages/*/src/` minus `.test.`, `.spec.`, `__tests__/`, `test/`, `tests/`). Lit control, same instrument over #7632 and #7714: 64 lines, 5 of them changeset and 20 src-nontest. No hit is a hex colour (the same pattern followed by a hex letter: 0).
- At the merge base `dac022c4e`: 204 lines. 20 changeset lines in 17 files, 38 src-nontest lines in 17 files, and out of scope 81 test, 28 scripts, 6 `.github`, 1 governed, 30 other. The card's "20 pending changesets" is 20 lines in 17 files, the same population the PM counted as 17 files. The card's own base `63835d998f` reads the same 20 / 17 / 38 / 17.
- All 17 changesets are still pending: no `CHANGELOG.md` names any of the ten (control: `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md` carries 140 `objectui#` mentions).

## Citation form

- The replacement is the 9-character backticked sha of the commit on `main` that landed the change the sentence rests on, the PR objectui#10707 / objectui#10766 form. Commits, not PRs: PR 7637 (the #7627 landing) answers 404 itself. Every replacement sha is an ancestor of the base (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 for each, which proves itself) and `git rev-parse --short=9` returns the same 9 characters for each.
- **A changeset's pointer to its OWN issue is dropped, not replaced.** `.changeset/config.json` names `@changesets/cli/changelog`, whose `dist/changelog.mjs` re-exports `@changesets/changelog-git`, and that generator prefixes every released entry with `changeset.commit.slice(0, 7)`, the commit that added the file. The landing sha is therefore already on the released line. PR objectui#10707 did the same for its two retirement changesets. Where a changeset cites ANOTHER change, the landing sha replaces the number.
- The dated-note form is not used: no edited sentence became false, only its pointer died. This is the prose-only correction the triage also allows.
- Source docblocks cite the landing sha at every site, including sites the landing commit itself wrote: a source comment carries no automatic hash the way a released changeset entry does.

## The runtime string (patch round)

`assertObjectMetadataWritable`'s thrown message now ends "(objectui#7714). " where it ended "(objectui#7714, objectui#8057). ". The dead pointer is dropped, not replaced by a sha, because a runtime reader has no repository to resolve one against (the PR objectui#10707 precedent). The change is declared by `.changeset/10771-write-guard-message-citation.md` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`: patch), and `10771-dead-citation-sweep.md` gains one sentence pointing at it. Nothing pins the string: `git grep` of the pointer fragments hits only the source line, and no test regex names the dead number.

- `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:metadata-write-doors`: exit 0 each.
- Through the shared verify lock (`VERDICT command-exit 0`): the `@object-ui/data-objectstack` dependency-closure build, its own build and `type-check`, and a repo-root vitest run over `packages/data-objectstack/`, the guard's app-shell callers and the three script suites that read the guard or `.changeset/**`: `Test Files 83 passed (83)`, `Tests 1109 passed (1109)`.
- `dist`: the new message is in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`; the old pointer text is in 0 files.
- Re-count, same census instrument: in scope at `c050ffe05` = 0 changeset lines, 0 src-nontest lines (before the patch round: 0 and 1). Lit control #7632 / #7714 on the same head: 65 lines, 6 changeset, 20 src-nontest.

Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `projectService`, no `project` parser option, no type-checked preset), so a comment diff cannot move another file's verdict.

**Declared narrowing.** NOT MEASURED locally: the full test suites and `type-check` of the other nine packages (`app-shell`, `components`, `core`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-tree`, `react`). Reason: the comment-stripped syntax tree of every touched file is identical, so only a test that reads source TEXT can move, and those ran above. CI runs the full farm.

## Serial

The branch merged `main` at `dac022c4e` before this PR opened, and again at `6cf599985` in the patch round (merge `566aac876`, no conflicts); merges only, no rebase. `git diff --stat` from the claim-time base to that commit over the 35 touched paths is empty. The one in-flight overlap the claim named, objectui#5157 in `ObjectMap.tsx`, is region-disjoint: this PR changes two comment lines above `resolveRecordSourceObjectName`'s call and nothing in the `safeParse` region. `.changeset/5793-spec-range-floors.md` is also in the release PR objectui#5400, which regenerates itself.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The same defect with other numbers, in the same files (not widened; filed by the seat as the family card objectui#10803).** The 34 in-scope files cite 318 distinct issue numbers. REST reads each: 296 answer 200 and 22 answer 404. Eight of the 22 are this card's numbers.
